title: Three strikes hit different zones of central Gaza after warning from the Israeli army
description:
(15 Jul 2026) 
RESTRICTION SUMMARY:

ASSOCIATED PRESS
Maghazi refugee camp, central Gaza Strip - 15 July 2026 
1. Various of Palestinian families walking in path surrounded by destruction after they received evacuation order from Israeli army 
2. Ball of flame rising into sky after Israeli airstrike, UPSOUND of explosion ++NIGHT SHOT++
3. Various of smoke following Israeli airstrike ++NIGHT SHOTS++

ASSOCIATED PRESS
Nuseirat refugee camp, central Gaza Strip - 15 July 2026 
4. Explosion following Israeli airstrike, UPSOUND of explosion ++NIGHT SHOT++
STORYLINE:
Three strikes hit central Gaza on Wednesday evening after the Israeli military issued a warning, according to area residents.

Dozens of people were seen carrying their belongings through the streets as they fled buildings that were later struck.

No casualties were immediately reported. 

Israeli strikes have been continuing across the Gaza Strip despite a fragile ceasefire between Hamas and Israel put in place in October. 

Over 1,100 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza since then, according to the Hamas-run health ministry.

At least five Israeli soldiers were killed in the same period.
